title: Implicit Neural Representation for 3D Radio Map Compression in Low-Altitude Environments
abstract: arXiv:2611.30445v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Low-altitude wireless networks require accurate 3D radio maps (RMs) to support environment-aware communication. However, due to the extensive spatial coverage and multi-modal channel representations, 3D RMs usually incur prohibitive storage and transmission overhead, making efficient compression highly desirable. In this paper, we propose NeRM3D, an implicit neural representation (INR)-based framework for compact 3D RM compression. Specifically, NeRM3D represents the entire 3D RM as a lightweight neural network that maps discrete height values to corresponding RM slices, thereby encoding the RM into a compact neural network. To effectively model the volumetric spatial structure of 3D RMs, NeRM3D jointly integrates horizontal embeddings with height-aware modulation, enabling efficient extraction and fusion of spatial correlations across different vertical layers and channel modalities. translated_abstract: 低空无线网络需要精确的三维无线电地图（RM）来支持环境感知通信。然而，由于空间覆盖范围广且信道表示具有多模态特性，三维无线电地图通常会带来高昂的存储和传输开销，因此高效的压缩方法变得十分必要。本文提出了NeRM3D，一种基于隐式神经表示（INR）的紧凑三维无线电地图压缩框架。具体而言，NeRM3D将整个三维无线电地图表示为一个轻量级神经网络，该网络将离散的高度值映射到相应的无线电地图切片，从而将无线电地图编码为紧凑的神经网络。为了有效建模三维无线电地图的立体空间结构，NeRM3D联合整合了水平嵌入与高度感知调制，能够高效地提取和融合不同垂直层和信道模态之间的空间相关性。实验结果表明，NeRM3D实现了……
tldr: 本文提出NeRM3D框架，利用隐式神经表示将三维无线电地图编码为轻量级神经网络，并结合水平嵌入与高度感知调制来建模立体空间结构，从而实现低空环境中三维无线电地图的高效压缩。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes NeRM3D, an implicit neural representation-based framework that encodes 3D radio maps as a lightweight neural network with horizontal embeddings and height-aware modulation to achieve efficient compression in low-altitude environments.
